text:
elaine: FYI rolled a small canary that switches runtime RPC to multiplexed gRPC streams + delta-frame compression for response payloads. initial results look great: end-to-end p50 down ~22%, p95 down ~18%, network egress down ~30% on chat-heavy workloads.

fermi: nice! which workloads were in canary and how many hosts?

elaine: canary: 12 hosts on dedicated-infer-pool-7. workload slice: chat-medium, assistant-longform, and a subset of high-concurrency webhooks.

priya: any compatibility caveats? do older clients need changes?

elaine: no client changes required for our hosted SDKs because the server negotiates streaming mode and falls back to plain unary. we added a short-lived feature flag `runtime.rpc.multiplex_v1` so we can flip back. self-hosted/private deployments need a runtime update.

deploy-bot: deploy:rpc-multiplex-canary started by elaine at 2221110008. canary hosts: 12.

rachel: can you paste perf numbers by model?

elaine: quick snapshot: chat-medium p50 latency -21.7%, p95 -17.9%, egress -28%. assistant-longform p50 -24.3%, p95 -20.1%, egress -35%. aggregate CPU on worker threads -9.8%. decoding latency improvement because we now stream token frames earlier and avoid large JSON serialization spikes.

priya: config diff?

elaine: diff:
```
# enabled multiplexed streaming with delta-frame compression
rpc.streaming.enable_multiplex = true
rpc.streaming.frame_codec = "delta_snappy_v1"
rpc.streaming.max_inflight_streams_per_conn = 8
rpc.streaming.frame_size_target = 8kb
```
We also reduced our per-message JSON envelope by switching to a binary frame header which cut serialization overhead.

fermi: any regressions or error patterns?

elaine: no increase in 5xx. small uptick in backpressure warnings during initial surge on 2 hosts (threads exhausted) — we bumped `max_inflight_streams_per_conn` from 4 -> 8 in the canary config and that smoothed it.

ops-bot: monitor note: added alerts for stream-reset-rate > baseline + 0.3% and conn-saturation > 70% for canary hosts.

rachel: rollout plan?

elaine: stepwise: 30% in 20m, 60% in 90m, 100% in 6h if no alerts. rollback via FF `runtime.rpc.multiplex=false`. auto-pause triggers: p95 latency > baseline + 6% OR stream-resets > baseline + 0.5%.

fermi: will add a dashboard panel in "runtime/transport" to compare unary vs multiplexed stream traces and per-tenant egress savings.

elaine: adding a short runbook for private customers (they need runtime >= 3.7.0). also documenting delta-frame decoding libs for our SDKs so partners can inspect frames if they want.

deploy-bot: canary completed at 2221110019  no alerts triggered.

elaine: summary: multiplexed streaming + delta compression gives meaningful E2E latency and network wins, low CPU win as well. grateful to infra/transport teams for the work. follow-up: we'll gather 24h and 72h metrics and post the full benchmark. cc @fermi @priya :rocket:

rachel: :thumbsup:
